name: MFLOUR
recent: Malayan Flour Mills 在2026年11月公布季度业绩，净利按年增长，主要受家禽业务带动。公司近期持续在公开市场回购股份，并披露董事在闭市期内的交易意向。此外，公司就 Dindings Poultry 与 MyCC 的司法复核取得高庭 interim stay。
notable: 公司公布最新季度业绩，净利按年上升。
公司近期持续进行股份回购。
高庭批准 Dindings Poultry 的 interim stay，以待 MyCC 司法复核。
risks: 公司披露董事在闭市期内有交易持股的意向。
公司有一项涉及清盘 / 接管 / 限制令 / 特别管理人的公告。
earnings: 最新季度（截至2026年6月30日）营收为 MYR 798.656 million，按季增长7.7%，按年微跌0.2%；净利为 MYR 42.933 million，按季增长1.1%，按年增长53.0%，净利率为5.4%。

recent_en: Malayan Flour Mills reported quarterly earnings in November 2026 with higher year-on-year net profit, driven mainly by poultry operations. The company has been actively buying back shares and disclosed directors' intention to deal during the closed period. It also obtained a High Court interim stay for Dindings Poultry pending judicial review against MyCC.
notable_en: The company announced its latest quarterly results with higher year-on-year net profit.
The company has been continuously buying back its shares.
The High Court granted Dindings Poultry an interim stay pending judicial review against MyCC.
risks_en: The company disclosed directors' intention to deal in securities during the closed period.
The company has an announcement related to winding up / receiver & manager / restraining order / special administrator.
earnings_en: For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 798.656 million, up 7.7% QoQ and down 0.2% YoY; net income was MYR 42.933 million, up 1.1% QoQ and up 53.0% YoY, with a net margin of 5.4%.
